screens.label: Entry
screens.objective: Entry/login screen — a brand moment, outside the navigation shell. Establishes the product's calm, trustworthy identity before any operational data appears.

screens.label: Home
screens.objective: Answer, within 2 seconds of reading, "Is Márcio okay?" — the product's central question (Principle 2.1). Also shows the edge device status without requiring extra navigation (Principle 2.6), covering flow 4.6.
componentes: DeviceStatusBadge (online/offline + last sync) — also present in the Topbar (3.2.B)
Quick link to the day's History

screens.label: Alarm
screens.objective: Be absolutely unmistakable at the moment Márcio needs help (Principle 2.2) and require explicit human confirmation before returning to the normal state (Principle 2.3). Covers flow 4.2 (the product's parent flow). *(Amendment 1)* This screen is **exclusive to `emergency` urgency commands** of the
componentes: AlarmOverlay (full-bleed, `--color-alarm` color, replaces any active screen)
Single confirmation button (no other action available — total focus)

screens.label: History
screens.objective: Allow the caregiver to review the day's/week's/month's events in human language (Principle 2.5) and record false-positive/false-negative feedback (flow 4.7). Covers flow 4.4.
componentes: EventListItem *(Amendment 1)* — shows the **command label** (`Event.command.label`), no longer a fixed gesture text (e.g., "water" or "Frog", in quotes — it is the family's word, not a description by the system); urgency badge (emergency/routine) next to the label

screens.label: Calibration
screens.objective: Allow a non-technical person to manage Márcio's **command catalog** (add, edit, remove) and calibrate each command independently — gesture, sensitivity and urgency level (Principle 2.4). Covers flow 4.3, now extended from "1 gesture" to "N commands, each with its own cal
componentes: CommandList *(new)* — lists the catalog, each item shows label, urgency badge (`--color-alarm` color for emergency, neutral color for routine), gesture (1 or 2 primitives) and sensitivity; action to open the editor or remove
CommandEditor *(new)* — form for the individual command, reuses the fields below; opens for "New command" or for editing an existing one
LabelInput — free-text field for the label (the family writes their own code word, e.g., "water", "Frog" — no suggestion or validation of meaning)
UrgencySelector *(new)* — binary emergency/routine choice, with an inline explanation that emergency triggers Screen 02 (full-bleed) and routine triggers only the toast (§3.2.E)
GestureSelector (dropdown with visual examples, not technical names) — used once for the main primitive, and optionally once more for the secondary primitive (compound gesture)
SensitivitySlider (visual, 3-5 named levels, not raw numeric values)
TestLiveButton (tests the gesture combination live before saving — critical when there are 2 primitives, since the risk of a false negative is higher, see LBC §12 Amendment 1)

screens.label: Onboarding
screens.objective: Initial registration of the tenant, patient and edge device pairing — carried out once by Danilo Amaral (technical lead), not by the caregiver day to day. Covers flow 4.5.
componentes: Step wizard (tenant → patient → device → first command → invitation)

screens.label: Converse
screens.objective: Category → phrase navigation of the speech tree, input-channel agnostic (gesture via GEST reusing engineFeatureRef, or direct touch) — Amendment 3 (2026-08-30), ADR-013 accepted. Runs inside the patient's restricted shell (patient-shell.component.ts), not the caregiver's shell.
componentes: SpeechTreeNavigator (grid of nodes at the active level)

screens.label: Activate patient's mobile phone
screens.objective: Caregiver provisions the PatientSession (ADR-012 accepted, Option C) and pairs the mobile phone as an edge device (ADR-014). Session does not expire; revocation always visible (constraint SEC-001). Reachable from Onboarding, not from the daily sidebar.

screens.label: Training
screens.objective: Caregiver starts/watches a conversation with the LLM (Claude/Anthropic API) to propose new CONV categories/phrases (English only) — Amendment 4 (2026-08-31), ADR-016 accepted. Runs in the caregiver's shell (DASH), occasional session, not daily. Scripted conversation in the prototype, no real API call.

screens.label: Confirm new phrases
screens.objective: Patient confirms/adjusts/rejects proposals already approved by the caregiver (Screen 08), at their own pace — Amendment 4 (2026-08-31), ADR-016 accepted (Dual Authorization, ADR-018). Runs inside the patient's restricted shell (patient-shell.component.ts). Reachable from the banner on Screen 06 when there are pending items.
